Regional indicators

Capacity, access and value

MRI regulatory activity & procurement

Equipment authorisations describe regulatory activity; procurement expenditure describes purchasing in the stated market. Neither establishes operational capacity or clinical benefit. The charts use separate scales, and their scope and periods must match before comparison.

Equipment & examination mix

Selected regional observations

Equipment mix shows the available technology; examination mix shows the clinical workload it supports. These have different denominators and are not revenue shares. Each system or examination has one category in its own breakdown; residual and unclassified entries remain visible.

Vendor revenue: sourced observations

Disclosed figures and explicitly sourced estimates for the selected region. Revenue scope, currency and period may differ. Whole-company revenues must not be presented as modality-specific equipment revenues. Equipment clearances and examination volumes are not used to infer market share.

Data coverage & interpretation
  • Reported values come from named sources; estimates retain their methodology and scope.
  • Clinical demand creates a need for capacity; facilities, staffing, commissioning and budgets determine whether equipment can enter service.
  • Selected FDA 510(k) clearances measure US regulatory activity in the stated product codes, not adoption, system sales or unique technologies.
  • Consumer price indices are cost-pressure proxies; they do not directly measure hospital input costs.
  • Equity benchmarks reflect wider healthcare sentiment rather than the specific imaging modality itself.
